summary: Composer publishes the DjangoLux maintenance page itself and hardens the resident stack.
highlights: The maintenance page ships in the Composer image; composer-agent publishes it on the runtime volume and the proxy serves it from there (DjangoLux stack schema 3).
'composer check --fix' moves an existing stack off its project maintenance page; a customised page is kept as the .proxy/maintenance/ override.
The resident stack is hardened: no write-enabled Docker socket proxy, DAC_OVERRIDE instead of DAC_READ_SEARCH, pinned images and actions.
Composer's version and release notes come from release-manifest.json, also exposed as the image label org.dlux.composer.release-manifest.
